disabled_reason: Returns JS bot-check stub (Client Challenge) on plain fetch. Requires Playwright/headless browser to render product list.
notes: Custom Finnish webshop platform. IMPORTANT: a plain requests/curl fetch of this URL returns only a ~3KB 'Client Challenge' JS bot-check stub, not the real markup — the page requires a JS-capable fetch (Playwright/headless browser) to render the actual product list. Confirmed 19 products, 'Näytetään tuotteet 1-19 / 19', all on one page (no pagination). Stock signal is a class on the product_container article itself (e.g. 'AvailabilityInStock'/'AvailabilityOutOfStock'), not a descendant — check the container's own class list, same pattern as tcgkauppa.fi. Caution: a per-product badge span.ProductOutOfStockBadge with text like 'Poistunut myynnistä toistaiseksi' can still appear on a container marked AvailabilityInStock (likely refers to a specific variant/restock, not overall availability) — trust the container's Availability* class over that badge text. Price format clean, e.g. '6,99 €'.
